verdict.rationale: Relay explicitly advertises high-yield accounts with automated rules for building a cash cushion (relay-docs-6), and community evidence confirms automatic money partitioning with some interest on allocated funds (relay-comm-1), supporting the core capability. However, there's no detailed documentation on yield rates, sub-account mechanics, or transfer rule configuration depth, and the community note indicates manual steps still required for some flows, so delivery is credible but under-specified.
